අති විශෙෂ
No. 2409/39 - THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 07, 2024
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7

My No.: DS/IMA/LAN/05/02/31. Land Ministry’s Ref. No. : 4-3/18/2020/WS/244. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose :

Description of the Land to be acquired : Two allotments of land marked as Lot Nos. 01 and 02 in Total Extent of 0.8545 Hectare and depicted in Cadastral Map No. 810343 of 15.08.2024 made by the Survey Superintendent, situated in the Village of Imaduwa, in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Imaduwa, District of Galle, Southern Province and the description of the allotment of lands are as follows :-
01. Lot No. 01 Name of the Land : Dachchakanaththahena, Mahahenkanaththa and Ekwaththekanaththa; Claimant : Mr. Lanka Somadewa Mendis Walawage; Extent : 0.7457 Hectare.

North : Lot No. W 104 (TP 192899), 3148 (TP 192900) and 3149 (TP 192901) of PP 1728; East : Lot No. 3148 (TP 192900) and 3149 (TP 192901) of PP 1728; South: Lot No. 3149 (TP 192901), 3148 (TP 192900) of PP 1728 and Lot No. 02 of this sheet; West : Lot No. 02 and Lot No. W 104 (TP 192899) of PP 1728 and Geeganage Kanaththa.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
(Published by Authority)
PART III — LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices
02. Lot No. 02 Name of the Land : Geeganagekanaththa; Claimant : Government; Extent : 0.1088 Hectare.

North : Lot No. 01; East : Lot No. 01, Lot No. 3148 (TP 192900) of PP 1728 and Geeganage Kanaththa claimed by Government; South: Road and Geeganage Kanaththa claimed by Government; West : Road and Geeganage Kanaththa claimed by Government.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land on which servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional Secretariat, Imaduwa on the 06th day of January 2025 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 16th Day of November 2024 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation and the details of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
S. A. M. Nasli, Divisional Secretary, Imaduwa. At Divisional Secretariat Imaduwa, 04th November, 2024. EOG 11 - 0052
